decision.title: The Obstacle Is the Way: The Timeless Art of Turning Trials into Triumph
decision.author: Ryan Holiday

alternativesConsidered.label: Expanded 10th Anniversary Edition
alternativesConsidered.reason: Later revised packaging adds chapter-level material and would change the run's chapter map.

whyLocked: The user named the unqualified base title rather than the expanded anniversary variant.
The 2014 original is the dominant canonical edition for the book's baseline chapter structure.
Locking the original avoids mixing revised anniversary content into a run that began from the base title.

materialAmbiguity.reasonNotAsked: The base-title request strongly indicates the original edition, and the original chapter map is the safest canonical lock for ChapterFlow.
